description: Change the page theme and the announcement banner across the top of it. Page themes, a custom theme colour (shown only when the theme is "custom"), your own banner colour, hiding the Kulhad badge, and a Google Analytics measurement ID are Premium. The measurement ID is stored as a page setting; Kulhad itself does not contact Google. Each value passed replaces the current one. Writes to the creator's own Kulhad account only.

badgeHidden.description: Hide the "Powered by kulhad" badge. Premium.

gaMeasurementId.description: A Google Analytics ID like G-XXXXXXXXXX. Premium. Empty string clears it.

occasionColor.description: The banner colour. "own" uses occasionColorHex and is Premium.

occasionColorHex.description: The banner colour when occasionColor is "own", as a six-digit code starting with a hash. Empty string clears it.

occasionText.description: The banner text. Empty string clears it.

occasionUntil.description: The last day the banner shows, as YYYY-MM-DD. It shows through the whole of that day, India time. Null or an empty string removes the end date.

themeColor.description: A six-digit colour code starting with a hash, for the custom theme. An empty string clears it.

name: update_page_appearance
title: Change how my page looks
